mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS solution_tag ( solution_id BIGINT NOT NULL, tag VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (solution_id, tag), INDEX idx_tag (tag) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO solution_tag (solution_id, tag) VALUES (#{solutionId}, #{tag})
mapper.select: SELECT tag AS name, COUNT(1) AS count FROM solution_tag GROUP BY tag ORDER BY count DESC, tag ASC
